name: components-community-radial-intro
title: Radial Intro
description: A ring of circular photos spins slowly around an empty middle, each picture staying upright as the ring turns.
use: A landing page or section needs a decorative orbiting visual to fill space beside copy.
avoid: The motion never stops and the centre is empty, so it cannot carry text and may distract from reading.
a11y: The orbit never stops and there is no prefers-reduced-motion check, so motion-sensitive users cannot pause it. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five small circular photos, each a different scene, sit evenly spaced on a ring on a black background, with nothing in the middle. All circles are the same size and stay upright as they move.
behaves: Photos fade and lift into their ring positions shortly after mount, then the whole ring rotates continuously while each photo counter-rotates so it never tips over. The linear spin never stops.
customise: Pass an array of items with id, name and src plus the stage and image sizes; the ring spacing, spring and 30-second spin are fixed in source.
weight: light: Five small images on one infinite transform spin; no canvas or WebGL.
